newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS-VW 9-mth pre-tax profit soars 56 pct.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-VW 9-mth pre-tax profit soars 56 pct.

text.p: Europe's largest carmaker, Volkswagen AG, on Wednesday reported its pre-tax profit soared 56 percent during the first nine months of the year and sales grew strongly.
VW said in a statement that group sales climbed 14.2 percent between January and September to a record 74.49 billion marks ($48.61 billion).
Pre-tax profit rose to 1.48 billion marks from 948 million, while after-tax earnings were 465 million marks, compared with 185 million for the same period in 1995.
The carmaker has surpassed its own expectations for much of this year, winning European market share by fighting to keep costs and prices down, analysts said.
Volkswagen said car production rose 8.7 percent during the first nine months to 2,741,914 units, while worldwide deliveries to customers climbed 12.6 percent to 2,986,977 units.
VW shares rose about three marks after the announcement to trade at 586.00 marks, a gain of 7.25 marks on the day.
Analysts often view VW profit figures sceptically because of accounting and tax provisions the company makes. ($1=1.5323 Mark)
